universe_history._note: Point-in-time Nifty 500 membership for backtests (removes survivorship bias): when enabled, every strategy scans scan_list (all stocks ever in the index) but enters a stock only on days it was a member; exits are never restricted; the breadth signal counts members only. Build the file with scripts/build_universe_history.py, then fetch bars with scripts/fetch_history.py --list nifty500_pit. Keep it OFF for live eod/open (today's list is already current).
